description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of two models, ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2, across different diffusion steps, with the x-axis representing the diffusion step (100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000) and the y-axis showing the ROUGE score. The chart includes three sets of bars for each diffusion step: ROUGE-1 (light blue with diagonal stripes), ROUGE-2 (light green with dots), and a third category (orange with dots). The ROUGE-1 scores increase from 6.3 at step 100 to 41.2 at step 2000, while ROUGE-2 scores increase from 0.1 to 19.1 over the same range. The third category shows scores of 3.0, 8.3, 15.9, 30.7, and 33.4, respectively. The ROUGE-1 scores are consistently higher than the other two categories across all diffusion steps.
